title: [review] generate_forwarding_buffer.py:339: Missing boundary test vector f
description: The expire_old logic at line 129 expires packets when deadline_ms <= now_ms, but no test vector verifies behavior at the exact boundary where now_ms equals deadline_ms. Existing tests use now_ms=150 for deadlines 100/200, missing the boundary case. An implementation that uses < instead of <= would pass these tests but violate the spec.
